title: Worzel's Story
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Wizards of the Coast short stories)

paragraphs.text: " Worzel's Story " is a short story about the planeswalker Worzel preparing to duel her rival Thomil . It was originally published in 1993 in the Alpha rulebook .

Worzel contemplates her previous duel with Thomil, in which she lost to his red magic and later learned white magic. After Thomil challenged her to another battle, Worzel summoned green creatures while looking for a Plains leyline which she lacked. She lamented not using blue magic for fear that Thomil might counter with his own. To her surprise, Thomil began using his own nearly learned magic: black magic. She readied her own newly learned white magic, and the fight begins.
